description: Complete machine-readable inventory of IMF indicators consumed by Riksdagsmonitor. Mirrors the shape of analysis/worldbank/indicators-inventory.json v3.0 so agents and TypeScript modules can discover IMF indicators with the same pattern they already use for World Bank. This file is the SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for IMF indicator discovery and MUST be kept in sync with scripts/imf-client.ts (IMF_WEO_INDICATORS, IMF_FM_INDICATORS) and scripts/imf-context.ts (IMF_INDICATORS).

clients.cli: tsx scripts/imf-fetch.ts (commands: weo, compare, sdmx, list-indicators)
clients.codes: scripts/imf-codes.ts (ISO3 country codes for the Riksdagsmonitor peer set, plus a legacy ISO3↔IMF-AREA mapping kept only for backward compatibility — SDMX 3.0 dataflows after the 2026-05 refactor accept ISO3 directly as COUNTRY and reject the legacy 3-digit numeric AREA codes)

notes.noMcp: IMF is NOT an MCP server. Agentic workflows invoke the TypeScript CLI via the bash tool. This keeps IMF under the same npm/SBOM governance as world-bank-client.ts and scb-client.ts with zero Python/uvx runtime.
notes.rateLimit: IMF advertises ~10 req / 5s. Prefer the 'compare' subcommand (single batched call) over parallel 'weo' calls. Client retries 3× on 429/5xx with 1s→2s→4s back-off.
notes.vintage: Every projection value carries a projectionVintage tag (e.g. 'WEO-2026-04', 'FM-2026-04'). Update DEFAULT_WEO_VINTAGE in scripts/imf-client.ts when the IMF publishes a new flagship release (April / October).
notes.persistence: Use the --persist flag to cache raw responses under analysis/data/imf/{indicator}/{country}.json. Reuse across article types within the same daily run to minimise API calls.

WEO.label: World Economic Outlook
WEO.coverage: Macro, fiscal, external sector, demographics. 190+ countries including all Nordic peers.

FM.label: Fiscal Monitor
FM.cadence: April / October (flagship releases, aligned with WEO)
FM.coverage: Deeper fiscal detail than WEO — primary balance, cyclically-adjusted balance, interest payments, debt-sustainability analysis.

CPI.label: Consumer Price Index (replaces the legacy IFS monthly CPI block)
CPI.coverage: Headline CPI levels, year-on-year inflation, and COICOP sub-indices for 200+ economies. The 2026-05 SDMX 3.0 refactor retired PCPI_IX and decomposed it into INDEX_TYPE × COICOP_1999 × TYPE_OF_TRANSFORMATION (e.g. Sweden all-items index = SWE.CPI._T.IX.M).
CPI.note: IFS (International Financial Statistics) is no longer published as a single SDMX 3.0 dataflow — its CPI block lives here, its policy-rate block in MFS_IR, and its exchange-rate block in ER.

BOP.label: Balance of Payments
BOP.coverage: Current account, capital account, financial account, reserve assets. Methodology: BPM6.
BOP.note: BOP_AGG is the aggregate summary; raw BOP has deeper detail.

GFS_COFOG.label: Government Finance Statistics — Classification of Functions of Government
GFS_COFOG.cadence: T+1 (data for year Y released in year Y+1)
GFS_COFOG.coverage: Government expenditure broken down by function (COFOG 01–10): 02 Defence → FöU, 07 Health → SoU, 09 Education → UbU, 10 Social Protection → SfU.
GFS_COFOG.note: Best source for committee-aligned spending decomposition. Indicator codes were renamed from G02/G07/G09/G10 to GF02_T/GF07_T/GF09_T/GF10_T in the 2026-05 refactor; SECTOR=S13 (general government), GFS_GRP=G2MF, TYPE_OF_TRANSFORMATION ∈ {POGDP_PT (% of GDP), POTO_PT (% of total expenditure), XDC (national currency)}.

MFS_IR.label: Monetary & Financial Statistics — Interest Rates
MFS_IR.coverage: Money-market rates, deposit/lending rates, government-bond yields. Sweden indicators include MMRT_RT_PT_A_PT (money market) and S13BOND_RT_PT_A_PT (sovereign bond yield).
MFS_IR.note: FPOLM_PA (central-bank policy rate) is no longer in the SWE codelist — use Riksbank statistics for the styrränta directly, or proxy via MMRT money-market rate.

IMTS.label: International Merchandise Trade Statistics (replaces the legacy DOTS dataflow)
IMTS.coverage: Bilateral merchandise trade — exports and imports by partner country. Useful for NU/UU trade-policy coverage. INDICATOR codes: XG_FOB_USD (exports FOB), MG_FOB_USD / MG_CIF_USD (imports FOB / CIF), TBG_USD (trade balance).
IMTS.note: DOTS / DOT no longer exists as a SDMX 3.0 dataflow — bilateral trade lives in IMTS. The legacy TXG_FOB_USD / TMG_CIF_USD codes were renamed to XG_FOB_USD / MG_CIF_USD.

PCPS.label: Primary Commodity Prices
PCPS.coverage: Commodity price indices — energy, metals, food. Feeds inflation-drivers commentary. COUNTRY=G001 (global aggregate); INDICATORs include POILBRE (Brent), POILAPSP (avg of Brent/Dubai/WTI), PALLFNF (all-commodities index).
PCPS.note: Moved from IMF.STA to IMF.RES in the 2026-05 refactor.

ER.label: Exchange Rates
ER.coverage: Bilateral nominal exchange rates. INDICATORs: USD_XDC (USD per national currency), EUR_XDC, XDC_USD, XDC_EUR, XDR_XDC, etc. TYPE_OF_TRANSFORMATION ∈ {EOP_RT (end of period), PA_RT (period average)}.

indicators.name: Real GDP growth
indicators.description: Year-over-year change in real GDP. Headline macro indicator. Projected to T+5.

indicators.name: Nominal GDP (local currency)
indicators.description: Nominal GDP in domestic currency. Denominator for % of GDP ratios.

indicators.name: Nominal GDP (USD)
indicators.description: Nominal GDP converted to USD. Useful for cross-country size comparisons.

indicators.name: GDP per capita (USD)
indicators.description: Nominal GDP per capita. Living-standards comparator.

indicators.name: GDP per capita (PPP, international $)
indicators.description: Purchasing-power-parity-adjusted GDP per capita. Preferred for welfare / living-standards comparisons.

indicators.name: Inflation, CPI average
indicators.description: Average consumer-price inflation, annual. Primary monetary-policy reference. Projected to T+5.

indicators.name: Inflation, CPI end-of-period
indicators.description: Year-end CPI change. Complements average-period PCPIPCH for target-adjacent analysis.

indicators.name: Unemployment rate
indicators.description: WEO-definition unemployment. Projected to T+5. Methodology may differ slightly from SCB AKU; cite explicitly.
caveats: WEO LUR may diverge from SCB AKU by 0.1–0.3 pp due to definitional differences. Prefer SCB for Swedish-specific ground truth; use IMF for cross-country comparison.

indicators.name: Employment
indicators.description: Total employed persons (WEO definition).

indicators.name: General government gross debt (% of GDP)
indicators.description: Debt/GDP on general-government (EDP) basis. Superior to WB GC.DOD.TOTL.GD.ZS for EU/Nordic discussion because it follows GFSM 2014. Projected to T+5.

indicators.name: General government revenue (% of GDP)
indicators.description: Tax and non-tax revenue as share of GDP. Projected to T+5.

indicators.name: General government expenditure (% of GDP)
indicators.description: Total government spending. Projected to T+5.

indicators.name: General government net lending / borrowing (% of GDP)
indicators.description: Headline fiscal balance (surplus +, deficit −). Projected to T+5.

indicators.name: General government primary balance (% of GDP)
indicators.description: Fiscal balance excluding net interest. Key debt-sustainability indicator. FM vintage may differ slightly from WEO.

indicators.name: Cyclically-adjusted primary balance (% of potential GDP)
indicators.description: Structural fiscal stance — removes business-cycle effects from the primary balance. Preferred metric for assessing discretionary policy.

indicators.name: Current account balance (% of GDP)
indicators.description: Net external position (trade + primary + secondary income). Projected to T+5.

indicators.name: Exports of goods and services, volume
indicators.description: Real exports growth rate. Projected to T+5.

indicators.name: Imports of goods and services, volume
indicators.description: Real imports growth rate. Projected to T+5.

indicators.name: Consumer Price Index (monthly all-items)
indicators.description: Monthly CPI level. Complements annual WEO PCPIPCH with higher frequency. The 2026-05 SDMX 3.0 refactor retired the standalone PCPI_IX series — request the same value as `SWE.CPI._T.IX.M` against the IMF.STA/CPI v5.0.0 dataflow.

indicators.name: Central bank policy rate (proxy via money-market rate for SWE)
indicators.description: Riksbankens styrränta proxy / central-bank target rate, monthly. The IMF SDMX 3.0 SWE codelist no longer carries the FPOLM_PA central-bank rate directly — use `SWE.MMRT_RT_PT_A_PT.M` (money-market rate) as the IMF proxy, and prefer Riksbank statistics for the official styrränta.

indicators.name: SEK / USD exchange rate (period average)
indicators.description: Bilateral nominal exchange rate. Useful for monetary-policy coverage and trade commentary. SDMX 3.0 key: `SWE.USD_XDC.PA_RT.M` (period-average). Use TYPE_OF_TRANSFORMATION=EOP_RT for end-of-period.

indicators.name: Defence spending (COFOG 02, % of GDP)
indicators.description: General-government defence expenditure on COFOG function 02. Complements WB MS.MIL.XPND.GD.ZS with EDP-consistent methodology.

indicators.name: Health spending (COFOG 07, % of GDP)
indicators.description: General-government health expenditure on COFOG function 07. Complements WB SH.XPD.CHEX.GD.ZS.

indicators.name: Education spending (COFOG 09, % of GDP)
indicators.description: General-government education expenditure on COFOG function 09. Complements WB SE.XPD.TOTL.GD.ZS.

indicators.name: Social protection spending (COFOG 10, % of GDP)
indicators.description: General-government social-protection expenditure on COFOG function 10 (pensions, unemployment, family benefits).

indicators.name: Exports of goods, FOB (USD) — bilateral
indicators.description: Annual or monthly bilateral merchandise exports to a named partner country. The 2026-05 SDMX 3.0 refactor renamed TXG_FOB_USD → XG_FOB_USD and moved it from DOTS to IMTS.

indicators.name: Imports of goods, CIF (USD) — bilateral
indicators.description: Annual or monthly bilateral merchandise imports from a named partner country. The 2026-05 SDMX 3.0 refactor renamed TMG_CIF_USD → MG_CIF_USD and moved it from DOTS to IMTS.

indicators.name: All Commodities price index
indicators.description: IMF all-commodities price index. Inflation-drivers commentary.

indicators.name: Crude oil price (average of Brent, Dubai, WTI)
indicators.description: Benchmark oil price. Inflation-drivers + MJU energy-policy commentary.

indicators.name: Population
indicators.description: WEO population definition. Projected to T+5.

KU.note: Governance (CC.EST, RL.EST, VA.EST, source=75) is WB exclusive; IMF has no equivalent.

JuU.note: Crime / rule-of-law metrics are WB exclusive.

vintageDiscipline.rule: Every projection citation MUST include the vintage tag in parentheses — e.g. '(WEO Apr-2026, GGXWDG_NGDP)'. Historical citations do not need the tag. Any projection citation older than 6 months gets a warning annotation in methodology-reflection.md.
vintageDiscipline.cutover: When a new WEO release is published, update DEFAULT_WEO_VINTAGE in scripts/imf-client.ts and the 'current' field above in the same PR.
